_purpose: Phase 2.0 probe — single real-agent LLMLL cell. Pre-calibration gap-finding before the 9-cell Phase-2 matrix. Phase 2.0a (this version): k=1 with 540s per-turn budget. Secondary hypothesis (turn 2 differs from turn 1) deferred to a follow-up probe once primary hypothesis lands. Tests apparatus end-to-end with gemini (real LLM) on 002-bank-ledger × llmll × k=1 × 1 try.

agents.name: gemini-default
agents.cmd: gemini -y --skip-trust -p 'Read AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md for the repair-loop protocol, then problem.md for the spec and TARGET.md for the target adapter. If context/turn_NN_verifier.json files exist, read the most recent before emitting. Write your LLMLL solution to the filename indicated in TARGET.md.'
agents.note: Gemini CLI 0.41.2, default model. -y auto-approves all tool actions (required for unattended subprocess use). --skip-trust bypasses the workspace-trust prompt. Model captured in agent.stdout.log.
